$comment: Active catalog. It contains real engines only — there are no mock entries and nothing here is synthetic. Adding a model means editing this file: copy the host and model entries you run from config/examples/real-models.example.json, adjust them, and restart DSH. No code changes are needed for any engine whose adapter kind is already registered. See docs/adding-a-model.md. The two hosts below are declared startable:false deliberately — the hub talks to the endpoints you already run and never launches anything until you opt in.

hosts.$comment: Ollama runs as a background service you manage. `ollama serve` owns port 11434, and every pulled model is reachable through the same OpenAI-compatible surface. Set startable/stoppable to true and add a `start` command if you want the hub to launch it for you.
hosts.name: Ollama
hosts.notes: External process. The hub only ever probes /api/tags and posts to /v1/chat/completions.

hosts.$comment: ComfyUI has a graph API rather than a prompt endpoint, so it has its own `comfyui` adapter. A model points at a template with `adapterConfig.workflowPath`; the adapter writes the prompt into the CLIPTextEncode node wired to the sampler's `positive` link, queues the graph, polls /history, and downloads from /view.
hosts.name: ComfyUI
hosts.notes: External process: start ComfyUI yourself, then the hub queues graphs against it. The shipped catalog never launches an engine — a test enforces that — so if you want `start_model` to launch this one, set startable/stoppable to true and add a `start` command here (or override this row in your profile's cordis.patch.yml). On this machine the working command is: C:/ComfyUI/venv/Scripts/python.exe main.py --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 8188, with cwd C:/ComfyUI/src. Allow five minutes for a cold start, and set the deployment's allowProcessLaunch: true.

models.$comment: A generic starter. `adapterConfig.model` is the name Ollama knows the checkpoint by, so point it at something you have actually pulled: `ollama list` shows the names, `ollama pull llama3.2` gets this one.
models.name: Ollama text model
models.notes: Rename this to the checkpoint you run, or add one entry per checkpoint — several models may share the `ollama` host.

models.$comment: The template in config/workflows/ was captured from a real run. Z-Image Turbo is step-distilled: 8 steps at cfg 1.0 is its intended operating point.
models.name: Z-Image Turbo (ComfyUI)
models.notes: The template names the checkpoint, text encoder and VAE, so those files must exist in your ComfyUI models directory. Delete this entry if you do not run ComfyUI.
